form.label: SOC Executive Overview
form.description: High-level security posture and critical alerts - Primary dashboard for competition monitoring

search.query: (index=network sourcetype=zeek:notice) OR (index=linux sourcetype=suricata:fast priority=[1-2]) OR (index=linux sourcetype=cowrie) OR (index=linux sourcetype=wazuh:alerts rule.level>=12) | stats count
index=network sourcetype=zeek:notice notice_type IN ("C2_Beacon_Detected", "Malware_Callback") | stats dc(src_ip) as unique_sources
(index=linux sourcetype=linux_secure "Failed password") OR (index=windows EventCode=4625) | stats count

(index=network sourcetype=zeek:notice notice_type IN ("C2_Beacon_Detected", "Malware_Callback")) OR (index=linux sourcetype=yara) OR (index=linux sourcetype=linux_av:scan_summaries "hits") OR (index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Defender" EventCode IN (1116,1117)) | stats count

(index=network sourcetype=zeek:notice) OR (index=linux sourcetype=suricata:fast priority=[1-2]) OR (index=linux sourcetype=cowrie) | eval alert_type=case( sourcetype=="zeek:notice", "Zeek: " . notice_type, sourcetype=="suricata:fast", "Suricata: " . alert, sourcetype=="cowrie", "Honeypot Attack", 1=1, "Other" ) | timechart span=10m count by alert_type limit=10

(index=network sourcetype=zeek:notice notice_type IN ("C2_Beacon_Detected", "Malware_Callback") | eval detection_source="Zeek C2 Fingerprint", threat_name=notice_msg, affected_host=src_ip) OR (index=linux sourcetype=yara | eval detection_source="YARA Scan", threat_name="YARA Match", affected_host=host) OR (index=linux sourcetype=linux_av:scan_summaries "hits" | eval detection_source="Linux Malware Detect", threat_name="Malware", affected_host=host) OR (index=windows sourcetype="WinEventLog:Defender" EventCode IN (1116,1117) | eval detection_source="Windows Defender", threat_name=ThreatName, affected_host=host) | table _time, detection_source, threat_name, affected_host | sort -_time | head 50

format.colorPalette: {"Zeek C2 Fingerprint":#DC4E41,"YARA Scan":#F8BE34,"Linux Malware Detect":#F1813F,"Windows Defender":#CBA700}

panel.title: Top Internal Sources by Traffic Volume

search.query: index=network sourcetype=zeek:conn | stats sum(orig_bytes) as bytes_out, sum(resp_bytes) as bytes_in, count as conn_count by id.orig_h | eval total_MB=round((bytes_out+bytes_in)/1024/1024, 2) | sort -total_MB | rename id.orig_h as "Source IP", total_MB as "Total MB", conn_count as "Connections" | head 20

index=linux sourcetype=iptables | stats count as block_count by src_ip, dest_port | sort -block_count | rename src_ip as "Blocked Source IP", dest_port as "Target Port", block_count as "Block Count" | head 20

index=linux sourcetype=cowrie | spath | eval attack_type=case( isnotnull(username), "Login Attempt: " . username . "/" . password, isnotnull(input), "Command: " . input, 1=1, message ) | stats count, values(attack_type) as "Attack Details" by src_ip | rename src_ip as "Attacker IP", count as "Events" | sort -Events | head 30
